findings.text: The comment on `suiteTimeoutSeconds` points to an internal plan ("the T17 status") and does not say why the model suite needs 600 seconds while the other suites keep 420 seconds; the status file also says this policy came from a separate commit `7101799d`, not from T17. Fix: State the reason in the comment, for example "The model suite runs 32 modules with Hypothesis and needs more than the 420-second default", and remove the reference to the plan.
